parameters.apprise_url_plus: ringc://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.token_secret }} }@${ customer_secrets.{{ params.client_id_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.secret_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.from_phone_secret }} }
parameters.description:
`msg-to-ringcentral-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your RingCentral destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise), the open-source notification library, driven entirely by your own stored credentials at no cost. A paid variant ($0.001 per message) delivers to additional RingCentral destinations bound per enrollment.
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own RingCentral destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

client_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's RingCentral client id

from_phone_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's RingCentral from phone

secret_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's RingCentral secret

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's RingCentral token
